PREFIX eduo: <http://example.org/ontology/education#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT ?student ?course ?lecturer ?division
WHERE {
  ?student a eduo:Learner .
  ?student eduo:belongsTo ?division .
  ?student eduo:enrolledIn ?course .
  
  ?lecturer a eduo:Lecturer .
  ?lecturer eduo:employedAt ?division .

}
LIMIT 5000
